tasks.title: task complete no parameters feature

tasks.title: tag based priority system
tasks.description: A list of tags should be able to be configured under a priority configuration option. all tags in the list are ordered by highest to lowest priority. high priority gets colored red, lower priority is colored yellow, no priority tag is displayed as normal.

tasks.title: track command
tasks.description: task track should behave like `task add` but should default complete date and completed to today and true. this is just to mark that something was done for historical purposes. quick command for add and then done. maybe just do it recursively?

tasks.title: backlog feature
tasks.description: tags configured in backlog list don't show up in the list of tasks to do. maybe some way to groom tasks?

tasks.title: Remove 'list' command and replace with no arguments
tasks.description: If the app is run with no arguments, it should default to displaying the list. Similarly, task n should display the task details without needing to provide any other flags.
